wa_text: Hello! I saw the Kalenza Digital portfolio and would like to discuss a project.

about.title: We build brands that show their value at first glance.

cols.p: A studio for websites, brand identity, design and marketing. We pair aesthetics with strategy so every brand is perceived for what it is truly worth.
We start with the business, not the screen. Every visual decision serves a clear goal: credibility, clarity or conversion.
We work in English, Portuguese and Arabic, including bilingual sites with true right-to-left layouts. A real advantage for brands selling into the Middle East.

items.p: Corporate sites, landing pages, online catalogues and e-commerce. Fast, refined and built to turn visits into conversations.
items.note: Also available as bilingual AR · EN sites with a right-to-left layout.

items.p: Logo, colour palette, typography and brand guidelines. A coherent identity that raises perceived value at every touchpoint.
Social media, catalogues, sales decks, price lists and print. Materials that sell to the same standard as your website.
Planning, positioning, social media management and campaigns. Clear direction for steady, consistent growth.

marvessa.title: Marketing agency
marvessa.sector: Studio project · fictional brand Studio Marvessa
marvessa.context: How do you present an agency that works with brands in several countries, equally strong in every language?
marvessa.did: We designed an editorial site with a capsule header, headlines that appear word by word and a background that follows the reader.
marvessa.design: A condensed serif, cobalt blue on ink and light passages that set the reading rhythm.

ambrevel.title: Luxury perfumery
ambrevel.sector: Studio project · fictional brand Maison Ambrevel
ambrevel.context: How do you turn the richness of Oriental perfumery into a contemporary brand that is easy to present?
ambrevel.did: We created the brand, a website with collections and a new-release showcase, and a catalogue in the same language.
ambrevel.identity_text: Monogram, signature and palette extend to the website, the catalogue and the packaging.
ambrevel.design: Deep burgundy, rosy bronze and a high-contrast serif; dark photography keeps the bottles in the foreground.

ondessa.title: Aesthetics clinic
ondessa.sector: Studio project · fictional brand Clínica Ondessa
ondessa.context: How do you convey calm and care from the very first click and lead to a booking without friction?
ondessa.did: We created the Sage & Sand art direction and a website with treatments, the space and booking in a few taps.
ondessa.design: Sage green, sand and a soft serif; cards reveal a photo of each treatment on hover.

ardelis.title: Professional hair care
ardelis.sector: Studio project · fictional brand Ardelis Professional
ardelis.context: How do you give a professional salon line an image that matches the technical care it offers?
ardelis.did: We created a deep-green and copper visual system and applied it to the website and the sales deck.
ardelis.design: A circular monogram, a classic serif and product photography in natural light, from website to sales material.

process.title: From diagnosis to growth.
process.lead: A clear path, with you involved at every stage.

steps.p: We learn the business, the audience and the brand's goals.
We define positioning, messaging and the channels that matter.
We design identity, website and materials in one visual language.
We launch fast, responsive sites that are easy to manage.
We run social media and campaigns so the brand keeps growing.

points.p: Every visual decision has a business purpose: to be remembered, to earn trust, to sell.
Website, identity, design and marketing speaking the same language, with no noise between suppliers.
English, Portuguese and Arabic with the same level of care, including right-to-left websites.
